reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers502input lines, all initial/part2/independent/W3records, F1–F79, EF1–EF21, C1–C18, all25per-book K2/K3/K6/K8/K13cards and every budget/source/review/search/gap/role/currency/clock row. The source site is not a series or shared world. Keep titles distinct: 巫師你好，我是偽人; 一年抽取一詞條，模擬的也可以？; 咒回：特級的我去死滅打宿儺了！; 全人類的繼承者; 廢土邊境檢查官. Traditional-script mirror snapshots, partial/multipart hashes, platform/author metadata and member-versus-printed chapters stay qualified. Dated ongoing/Calibre/no-source claims are not current holdings/publication proof; no source acquisition, body read or hash recheck occurs.

F2: Initial windows contain19members,16whole/3partial, not14whole/5partial: fivewhole mimic, threewhole+onepartial humanity, threewhole+onepartial inspector, fivewhole+onepartial annual-traits.47836character units sum correctly. Part2has18members/16whole/2partial/46086units. B3initialreuse/targetedopen is not a whole institution window; later W5/W6fill named gaps. Independent section15also advances mimic membership and annual-traits sect terms; old next-pass lists are historical. Correct wrong cross-pointers to F60–F62wage/caps and F79gallery without renumbering. The missed LOCAL_LIBRARYroute is already acknowledged later. Source-reviewed/reader-return/spot-opened/rules-reconciled/drafted/gameplay remain separate, not all-source acceptance.

F3: Mimic:1000GBPcash versus800internal budget is a25percent premium over800;800is20percent below1000. Blood buyer1500,broker2000,advance1000and protagonist1200valuation are offer, payment schedule and opinion, not four paid sales. The host’s witnessed trade/secrecy oath and own stock do not vouch every identity or guarantee quality. Later darkweb/referral/read-access/offline-membership/invite-review terms have no fee found in those members, not proven universal free entry. Association source/trace/material access, actual rite/retry/site, identity anchor and specific charged power remain distinct. Ordinary pound anchors are authored and not contradicted merely by occult-market scale. Anchor-hunt/kill prototype is a proposed route, not a universal mandatory resolution.

F4: Annual traits: owned/equipped slots, actual realm odds, each lived year, simulated time, settlement scope and live-world divergence differ. Percent lists total100at each cited tier, but7/9/14slots retain their distinct V/Wscope. Martial-hall payment/health training/referral versus bluff affiliation, sect root-grade test, office seat, spiritual realm and vassal dependence remain separate.70percentharvest tithe, unspecified earnings tuition, monthly rival-sect tax and later court monopoly are era/institution-specific, not one perpetual combined levy. Silver and source stone lack a supplied universal rate/price table; authored copper is not source currency. Memory/matter/relationships/fuel carries require that simulator’s actual contract, not a universal simulator law.

F5: Challenge-board fan novel: projection/attempt/archive/submission/permanent visit, host versus shared Maki body/soul, allowed techniques/rewind/lives, abort and failure are separate operations. Harder by third same-world challenge does not prove every arbitrary repeated activity a fixed third-use cap. The altered2018date/26th→27thhead/will notice/ceremony, Hei/Kugutsu access/service/reform and paid cleaning remain this fan novel’s branch, not automatically mainstream JJKcanon. Most elders obeying a will does not establish universal absolute office power. Clan recognition versus wider registration explains C15without pretending all audiences saw the will simultaneously. No fee found in selected board windows is not a free global economy or a complete ordinary-life loop.

F6: Humanity heir: public-use credential, private ownership, actual living-human status, detector reading/model cap, noble title and office differ. Detector cap30does not itself explain every lord title;29.3favour and20nobleband are different facts. The gallery’s collective weight dominates the named council/proposal-seat group and each gallery person has fewer votes; exact one-vote weight is inferred, not established.5000seats are not proof every vote is cast, and no fractional/integer weight is measured. Machine fact adjudication is not motive-reading/omniscience; link control, recorder loss, Church deputy eligibility, nun orders, institute and contested forge rights stay mechanism-specific. Keep817200claimed compensation versus690000+137200=827200itemized discrepancy, counterfeit face/real value and200–300yearstaxassignment; no invented tax rate or universal currency follows.

F7: Border inspector: checkpoint staff/prosecutor office/collector rank/promotion route are separate ladders and snapshots. Later24contribution-point wage credit,43balance and143after100transfer are account observations; pay period and exact wage/balance chronology need source qualification. They do not settle every trainee’s wages or exchange happiness coins with strategic points. Loan caps10/100perperiod, constrained transfers/gifts, unwritten personal-sale70versusseizure100and30riskgap, permits, actual paid charging5/15pointsper100kWh and free station slow charge retain supplier, custody, actor claim and eligibility. Cooperation percentage is a method eligibility meter, not automatic informed consent or universal moral/legal authorization. Route choice can expire in this source; current cap, percent charge, energy units and million-unit function unlock are not interchangeable counters. Cell capacity/72hourhold/quota liability is the source institution’s incentive, not a medically validated or adopted safe default.

F8: Preserve useful witness/no-guarantee trade, official/grey quote, tithe, weighted vote, credential bundle, branch contract/abort, real loan/stock/fee, expiring route option and future-tax settlement ideas separately in the five cards. Existing per-book generic schematics remain proposals; date old no-runtime/name-search census rather than inferring current implementation absence. Adequate floor/source readiness is not actual source-native binding or gameplay. Current PROJECT governs sequencing and AD42makes human review optional; no shared five-book launch gate, worker/reader, new acquisition, gameplay/code change, build/browser/save, deletion/move, commit or push occurs.
